description: This file implements a function to create a Sys Setup Manager object within a larger system environment. It contains licensing information, a license overview, and the implementation of the SysCreateSetupManager function, which delegates object creation to SysSmoCreate.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SysCreateSetupManager(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates a new Sys Setup Manager object using the provided context handles and delegates the creation to SysSmoCreate.
